body: باقي ساعتين على إطلاق 60 قمرًا صناعيًا بواسطة شركة SpaceX وهذا يعتبر خطوة أولى لعمل شبكة من الإنترنت لكل سكان الكرة الأرضية في المستقبل القريب Live!

en.title: Live: two hours until SpaceX launches 60 satellites
en.excerpt: Two hours until SpaceX launches 60 satellites, a first step towards an internet network for everyone on Earth in the near future.
en.body: Two hours left until 60 satellites are launched by the company SpaceX, which is regarded as a first step towards making an Internet network for all the inhabitants of the Earth in the near future. Live!
